message.name: HR-OPN-2026-0022
message.description:
Role Overview

  1. We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Java Developer with hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Java backend development, Microservices architecture, cloud technologies, and messaging systems, along with the ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  2. Develop and manage Microservices-based architecture for enterprise applications.
  3. Build RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services.
  4. Work with messaging systems such as Kafka and ActiveMQ for asynchronous communication.
  5. Deploy and manage applications using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
  6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including QA, DevOps, UI, and Product teams.
  7. Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using Keycloak and Kong API Gateway.
  8. Work with AWS cloud services for deployment and infrastructure management.
  9. Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.
  10. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  11. Maintain code quality using version control and best development practices.

Required Skills

  1. Strong experience in Java (Java 8/11/17 preferred)
  2. Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Microservices architecture
  3. Experience with Kafka/ActiveMQ
  4. Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines
  5. Experience with AWS cloud platform
  6. Expertise in Keycloak and Kong API Gateway
  7. Strong understanding of Git version control
  8. Experience working in Agile methodology
  9. Database knowledge: MariaDB and MySQL
  10. Hands-on experience with Apache Camel
  11. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills

Good to Have Skills

  1. Grafana
  2. Prometheus
  3. SonarQube
  4. Monitoring and observability tools experience

Preferred Qualifications

  1. M.Tech./ B.Tech. degree in computer science/Information Technology/or related field
  2. Good communication and teamwork skills
  3. Ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks efficiently

What We Offer

  1. Opportunity to work on scalable enterprise applications
  2. Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment
  3. Exposure to modern cloud and DevOps practices
  4. Career growth and learning opportunities

message.name: HR-OPN-2026-0021
message.description:
Description

We are looking for an enthusiastic App UI/UX Designer to understand user needs and create intuitive, visually appealing designs for mobile and web applications. The role involves collaborating with developers and stakeholders, ensuring design consistency, and staying updated with the latest UI/UX trends.


Role & Responsibilities:

· Conduct user research and develop user personas to understand target audience needs

· Create wireframes, prototypes, and user flows for mobile and web applications

· Design intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces for apps and websites

· Perform usability testing and gather feedback to improve user experience

· Collaborate with developers, product managers, and stakeholders for design implementation

· Enhance user journeys by optimizing navigation, interaction, and overall experience

· Create design systems, style guides, and UI components aligned with brand guidelines

· Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in UI/UX design


Preferred Candidate Profile:

· 2–3 years of experience in UI/UX design

· Bachelor’s degree in Design, Computer Science, IT, or a related field (B.Des / B.Tech / BCA / MCA preferred)

· Design Tools: Figma (Advanced), Adobe XD, or Sketch

· Graphic Assets: Adobe Illustrator & Photoshop (for custom icons and image editing)

· Web Basics: Strong understanding of HTML5/CSS3

· Framework Awareness: Basic knowledge of Material UI, Bootstrap, or Tailwind CSS layouts

· Good understanding of UX principles, interaction design, and usability testing

· Strong communication skills to justify design decisions based on user logic

· Detail-oriented with a keen eye for alignment, spacing, and colour consistency

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

message.name: HR-OPN-2026-0015
message.description:
1. Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)

  1. Embed security controls across all SDLC phases (design → build → deploy → operate)
  2. Conduct threat modeling (STRIDE, attack trees) during architecture design
  3. Define and enforce secure coding practices aligned with OWASP Top 10
  4. Integrate automated security gates into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins / GitHub Actions
  5. Establish security acceptance criteria for releases


2. Application Security (AppSec)

  1. Implement SAST, DAST, and SCA pipelines using tools like SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, Snyk
  2. Perform manual secure code reviews for critical services
  3. Identify and mitigate vulnerabilities such as:
  4. SQL Injection
  5. Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
  6. CSRF, SSRF
  7. Enforce remediation SLAs and track vulnerabilities lifecycle


3. Container, Kubernetes & Runtime Security

  1. Harden container images (minimal base images, remove unnecessary packages)
  2. Perform image scanning (Trivy, Clair) and enforce vulnerability thresholds
  3. Secure Kubernetes clusters:
  4. RBAC (least privilege)
  5. Network Policies
  6. Pod Security Standards / OPA Gatekeeper
  7. Implement runtime threat detection (Falco, eBPF tools)
  8. Enforce image signing and verification (Cosign, Notary)


4. Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  1. Design and implement secure cloud architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  2. Enforce:
  3. VPC isolation (private/public segmentation)
  4. Security groups & NACL hardening
  5. Encryption (KMS, TLS)
  6. Scan Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) using Checkov / tfsec
  7. Implement CSPM tools (AWS Security Hub, Prisma Cloud)
  8. Ensure compliance with CIS benchmarks


5. Identity, Access & Secrets Management (IAM)

  1. Implement Zero Trust principles (never trust, always verify)
  2. Enforce least privilege access across systems
  3. Manage secrets via HashiCorp Vault / AWS Secrets Manager
  4. Automate secrets rotation and eliminate hardcoded credentials
  5. Implement SSO, MFA, and role-based access control (RBAC)


7. Network Security

  1. Design secure network architectures:
  2. Firewalls, WAF, reverse proxies
  3. VPNs and private connectivity
  4. Implement intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS)
  5. Segment networks to reduce blast radius
  6. Protect APIs with rate limiting, API gateways, and authentication (OAuth2, JWT)


8. Security Monitoring

  1. Implement centralized logging (ELK / OpenSearch stack)
  2. Configure monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana


9. Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing

  1. Perform regular vulnerability scans (Nessus, OpenVAS)
  2. Conduct internal/external penetration testing
  3. Prioritize vulnerabilities using CVSS scoring
  4. Track remediation and ensure closure within SLA
  5. Maintain vulnerability dashboards and reports


10. Compliance, Risk & Governance (GRC)

  1. Ensure compliance with:
  2. ISO 27001
  3. SOC 2
  4. PCI-DSS (if applicable)
  5. Conduct risk assessments and threat analysis
  6. Maintain audit logs and compliance evidence
  7. Define and enforce organizational security policies


11. Endpoint & Host Security

  1. Harden Linux/Windows servers (patching, baseline configs)
  2. Implement EDR/XDR tools (CrowdStrike, Defender)
  3. Monitor host-level activities and detect anomalies
  4. Ensure secure SSH access and disable unnecessary services

message.name: HR-OPN-2026-0012
message.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive QA Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of our client applications. The candidate will be responsible for designing and executing test cases, identifying defects, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.


Key Responsibilities

  1. Analyze requirements and create test plans, test cases, and test scenarios
  2. Perform manual (functional, regression, integration)
  3. Execute API testing using tools like Postman / REST Assured
  4. Identify, log, and track defects using tools like Jira
  5. Perform regression testing for new releases
  6. Collaborate with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams
  7. Ensure adherence to quality standards and best practices
  8. Prepare test reports and documentation


Required Skills

  1. Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
  2. Experience in manual testing and test case design
  3. Hands-on experience in API testing
  4. Basic knowledge of automation tools (Playwright / Selenium / Cypress)
  5. Familiarity with bug tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, etc.)
  6. Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology
  7. Good analytical and problem-solving skills


Preferred Skills

  1. Experience in performance testing (JMeter / Gatling)
  2. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  3. Basic knowledge of programming/scripting (JavaScript, Java, Python)
  4. Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus)


Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
  2. 2–5 years of experience in software testing


Nice to Have

  1. Experience in test automation framework design
  2. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS)
  3. Understanding of microservices architecture


Soft Skills

  1. Strong communication skills
  2. Attention to detail
  3. Team collaboration
  4. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
